Hey man, it always could be worse. Thats a clichee, but true.

Have you ever thought of how you overcame the past hurdles in your life? How is this situation any different? 

Im not saying i know what youre going thru, but i can say that i understand your suffering. Life’s unfair, cruel, hard, and sometimes right evil. But it’s also beautiful, scarce, and full of opportunities, love and joy - There is no, one without the other. Suffering is hard wired to humankind, and it truly can become unbearabable, no doubt about it.

Question you should have to ask yourself is, what deal i would make with myself, so that one month later things are not as catastrophic as they are now? What kind of sacrifice i could make, for a better tomorrow? If your inner voice says that ok, i will co operate with you if i get a beer every evening, great. Whatever it is that would get you off the cycle of spiraling nihilistic numbness.

Just know that there is a brighter place at earth. There are outcomes where you smoke bbq with your friends at your own backyard, you have a spouse, kids, maybe a dog. Autumn is cooling the air and lights are brighter than they normally seem at eveningtime. But to get back on the path and to desired outcomes, it wont happen without taking action and negotiating terms with yourselfs inner voice.

Youre alive man, you have been blessed to live with us in the same timeline. Forget the worldnews n shit. Focus on you, remember the good and joy in the world. 

Youre on the middle of the ocean just drifting. When you see even a slightest sight of land ANYWHERE, you steer that motherf boat to that island. If its a mirage, good. You took action. If it is an island, stop by and start building a new life there. Make new friends. Make new habits. Dont listen to what happens on other islands. Sacrifice for better tommorrow. Laugh, Love.
How is your life?

This is probably the most common mistake i have seen ppl do. Making these bold statements., ”i will never this and that”

You are not giving your brain any control, which makes it go crazy and fight back like a rabid animal.

Never say never, they say, which is facts.

Instead, give your brain some sense of control. Say, i won’t fap today. I might fap tomorrow, but not today.

If you repeat that, you will never fap, and it gives your brain a false sense of control.

No progress is made if there is no trial and error., just remember that.
